name: Short-circuit Cave Noise Evaluation
aliases: Deterministic fixed-point cave density field optimization
definition: An optimization for procedural cave generation that avoids computing the second trilinear noise field when the first band check fails, reducing per-voxel generation cost.
summary: Short-circuit Cave Noise Evaluation optimizes procedural cave generation by skipping the second noise field computation when the first check fails, reducing per-voxel cost compared to eager evaluation.
